decision_question: Is this candidate suitable for public source distribution as a bounded referral follow-up companion?
criteria: Keep contact, requisition, request, sent message, and completed referral distinct.
Respect scoped user authority and protect private data and untrusted input.
Stop on uncertain send or unsafe concurrent writes.
Provide useful portable instructions and synthetic cases without claiming unrun performance.

claim_ledger.claim: Outreach is distinct from application-status reconciliation.
evidence: Existing application status reconciliation excludes sending messages.
claim_ledger.consequence: Overlapping contracts could produce contradictory writes.
claim_ledger.next_test: Recheck overlap when adjacent packages change.

claim_ledger.claim: The contract separates approval, delivery, and referral outcomes.
claim_ledger.consequence: A user could receive a false completion report or unauthorized disclosure.
claim_ledger.next_test: Execute the cases in an isolated host with a blinded grader.

claim_ledger.claim: Concurrent updates and uncertain sends are bounded.
claim_ledger.consequence: A duplicate message or lost user edits could result.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run an instrumented host simulation with timeout and concurrent edits.

claim_ledger.claim: Observed task benefit or measured uplift is established.
claim_ledger.consequence: A release claim could overstate reliability.
claim_ledger.next_test: Freeze a runner and perform matched blinded trials on an unseen external holdout.

reviewers.finding: approve-with-limits; evidence anchors and synthetic cases present
approve-with-limits after clarifying draft-to-send approval and the combined message-and-attachment boundary
approve-with-limits; no unresolved critical defect identified

Tested older identical message after a timeout, changed approved content with a concurrent edit, and a promise mistaken for a formal referral. No surviving contradiction was found in the instructions; no live executor ran.
The scoped source candidate may be distributed with evaluation and host-readiness limits. Previous review findings were fixed and affected files re-reviewed.

independence_limits: Separate reviewer contexts shared the same model family and inherited source history. The disruptor role was a separate pass, not an independent model family. Private source details were not included in this package.
expiry_trigger: A material skill, host, authorization, or evaluation change requires a fresh review.
